$comment: The Lantern Guild's sellswords (world doc §4 v1.11, GDD §6.2): what the player reads about ranks and perks. The ids are the sim's (src/sim/companions.js) and test/companions.test.mjs keeps them in step; the numbers in a line are the sim's numbers.

wick.name: Wick
wick.line: New to the Guild. Cheap, and mostly what they say they are.

lamp.name: Lamp
lamp.line: A few seasons on the road and still alive, which says something.

lantern.name: Lantern
lantern.line: Known in more than one town. Keeps one trick back until they trust you.

beacon.name: Beacon
beacon.line: A name the Vale would know. Rare, dear, and worth it.

found.name: Companion
found.line: Not the Guild's. Takes no wage.

bodyguard.name: Bodyguard
bodyguard.text: Within 3 tiles of you, takes a fifth of every blow aimed at you.

skirmisher.name: Skirmisher
skirmisher.text: +20 % damage to a foe that's fighting someone else.

finisher.name: Finisher
finisher.text: +15 % damage to a foe under half its health.

last_stand.name: Last Stand
last_stand.text: +20 % damage while under a quarter of their health.

field_medic.name: Field Medic
field_medic.text: Every 12 s in a fight, patches up the most hurt of you for 5 % of their max HP.

kindler.name: Kindler
kindler.text: Firebolt also burns those beside its target, for 0.3×.

old_campaigner.name: Old Campaigner
old_campaigner.text: Party aura: everyone regains HP 10 % faster in a fight.

deserters_bond.name: Deserter's Bond
deserters_bond.text: +10 % ATK if you left the Redhand too.

sisters_ward.name: Sister's Ward
sisters_ward.text: Their heals are 15 % stronger if you were a Grey Sisters' ward.

delvers_eyes.name: Delver's Eyes
delvers_eyes.text: +10 % ATK on a site's second floor and deeper, if you were Deepdelver-fostered.

shield_brother.name: Shield-brother
shield_brother.text: +10 % DEF while another fighter is in the party.

haggler.name: Haggler
haggler.text: The inn and the temple cost you 15 % less.

greedy.name: Greedy
greedy.text: Wants half again the wage. Foes drop 5 % more gold.

drinker.name: Drinker
drinker.text: −5 % ATK unless you've slept at an inn in the last two days.
